name: Universe
description: Universe is a ticketing and event-management platform for publishing event listings, selling tickets, managing guests and teams, checking attendees in and integrating event, sales and registration data.
agentUseSummary: Universe is visible as an OAuth provider-review preview. Relay will enable a bounded connection after Universe approves the app for durable refresh tokens and confirms the production data contract.

capabilities.label: Access authorized event data
capabilities.description: After approval, expose bounded event-management capabilities within the consenting Universe user's or team's authority.

blocked.label: Connect before provider approval
blocked.description: Relay has not received Universe approval for durable refresh tokens and the production callback.

blocked.label: Distribute a non-approved monthly grant
blocked.description: Relay will not ship a connection that forces users through OAuth again every thirty days because the app cannot refresh.

blocked.label: Access people and sales data before contract review
blocked.description: Guests, buyers, tickets, sales, check-ins and webhook payloads remain unavailable until the approved contract is reviewed and bounded.

blocked.label: Run Universe agent actions before approval
blocked.description: No REST, GraphQL, mutation, webhook or raw action is callable while provider review is pending.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider review pending
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until Universe approves durable refresh for Relay and its exact production callback.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Universe approves Relay's durable OAuth application and production callback.
No Hermes tools are callable until Universe approves Relay's durable OAuth application and production callback.

providerSetup.blocker: Universe documents that non-approved apps receive a 30-day access token without a refresh token, while approved apps receive refresh tokens and can request indefinite refresh. Relay has not obtained that approval for its production callback.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, create the Relay Universe OAuth application with https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/universe/callback, request approval and indefinite refresh, then review the approved REST/GraphQL data contract before implementing bounded tools and live consent validation.

evidence.supports: Universe documents the authorization-code grant at its fixed authorization and token endpoints, the public scope, confidential client secret, bearer tokens and 30-day expiry.
Universe states that non-approved apps have 30-day access without refresh, approved apps receive refresh tokens, and indefinite refresh requires contacting Universe.
Universe permits third-party applications to access a user's data only after the user grants permission through OAuth.
Universe describes event, attendee, sales, discount, access-key and check-in data and operations, which require a bounded post-approval product contract.
